project.name: @kehto/nip
project.summary: A TypeScript library of Nostr NIP helpers that nostr-tools does not ship, each at its own import path (@kehto/nip/5d, /65, ...). Its centrepiece checks and loads a napplet (a small sandboxed web app published on Nostr) from its signed manifest event; the rest parse relay lists, relay-discovery reports, lists/sets and app-handler announcements.

nodes.label: Package entry
nodes.summary: The one import that re-exports every NIP helper, plus the build settings that publish each NIP at its own import path.

nodes.label: Napplet loader (NIP-5D)
nodes.summary: Checks a napplet's signed manifest event, fetches its app bytes by hash and refuses anything whose signature or hash doesn't match.

nodes.label: Resolve and verify
nodes.summary: The main entry: verifies the signature, picks the right manifest parser, fetches and hashes the artifact, and reports failures with a stable error code.

nodes.label: Manifest formats
nodes.summary: Reads the current manifest tag layout and, for older publishing tools, the legacy layout, with a warning when the old one is used.

nodes.label: Media and source info
nodes.summary: Reads optional screenshots, preview videos and source-code pointers from a manifest, ignoring malformed entries instead of failing.

nodes.label: Saved app copies
nodes.summary: Keeps already-verified napplet bytes in the browser's built-in storage within size budgets and freshness windows, so repeat loads skip the download.

nodes.label: Aggregate hash (NIP-5A)
nodes.summary: Computes and checks the single hash that fingerprints a whole set of published files, used by the legacy napplet manifest format.

nodes.label: Relay discovery
nodes.summary: Helpers for finding which relays (Nostr message servers) to use: a person's own read/write relay list and community relay-monitor reports.

nodes.label: Relay lists (NIP-65)
nodes.summary: Parses a person's published relay list and keeps the latest one per person to pick where to read and write.

nodes.label: Relay monitor reports (NIP-66)
nodes.summary: Subscribes to relay-monitor reports through a supplied relay pool and groups relays by the attributes they advertise.

nodes.label: Lists and app handlers
nodes.summary: Parsers for personal lists and sets (mutes, bookmarks, relay sets...) and for announcements of which apps can open which kinds of event.

nodes.label: Lists and sets (NIP-51)
nodes.summary: Parses list and set events, including private items decrypted with a caller-supplied decryptor.

nodes.label: App handlers (NIP-89)
nodes.summary: Parses app-handler announcements and recommendations and builds the link that opens an event in a handler app.

nodes.label: Tests
nodes.summary: Automatic checks for every NIP helper, kept next to the code they test.

nodes.label: nostr-tools
nodes.summary: The standard Nostr toolkit; used for event types and signature checks.

nodes.label: @noble/hashes
nodes.summary: Audited hashing library; supplies SHA-256 for artifact and aggregate hashes.

flows.title: Load a napplet safely
flows.description: How a host turns a signed manifest event into trusted app bytes.

steps.note: The host hands resolveNapplet the manifest event and a function that downloads bytes by hash.
The event's signature is checked first; a bad signature stops everything.
The tags are read with the current format, or the legacy one with a warning.
Legacy manifests are checked against their aggregate hash of all files.
If a cache was supplied, verified bytes are reused or saved for next time.
